initial_findings.issue: open_review permits a fresh review while finding IDs and mandatory carry-over are scoped to one review. After a limit refusal, another review for the same branch could reach peer_complete without prior blockers.
initial_findings.requested_change: Persist lineage or reject replacement resets, with a limit-refusal replacement acceptance test.

lenses.resolution: One persisted series per repository ID and configured ref pair; uniqueness, counters and findings survive reopening and policy changes.

initial_findings.issue: Verbatim carry-over can exceed the 256 KiB verdict limit after a valid near-limit initial verdict, making later closure impossible.
initial_findings.requested_change: Reserve carry-over capacity or reference immutable finding records, and test near-limit closure.

initial_findings.issue: The phrase rejecting existing database files prevents a second participant or restart from opening the shared store.
initial_findings.requested_change: Accept validated existing regular databases and reject symlink/reparse files; test shared startup and restart.

lenses.resolution: Immutable finding references replace repeated text; finding/reason limits and maximum-ledger/coverage reservation require a plan-level byte proof. Existing validated regular databases are explicitly accepted.

lenses.recheck: No findings at either 13b2a28 or 5c93d6b within the explicit trusted local-operator boundary.

initial_findings.issue: Unspecified Git path encoding and ordering could collapse or reject non-UTF-8, case-distinct or normalization-distinct paths differently across platforms.
initial_findings.requested_change: Require reversible raw-byte identity and ordering with parity fixtures, or explicitly reject unsupported paths.

lenses.resolution: Raw bytes, base64 transport, unsigned-byte ordering and informational display labels; explicit path parity fixtures.

initial_findings.issue: Every mutation needs an expected store version, but only author-only open_review explicitly returns it; reviewers lack a specified refresh path after CONFLICT.
initial_findings.requested_change: Return observed versions from reads/status, resulting versions from writes, and specify conflict refresh.

lenses.resolution: Version-bearing responses and role-independent review_status refresh; explicit freshness discriminants and replay observation semantics.

lenses.applicability: Not applicable: this proposed spec has no separate approved controlling spec and is not its own trusted context.

verification: Documentation-only change. Staged and unstaged whitespace checks passed; product tests were not run and product implementation has not begun.
